title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi
description: Study Jami' at-Tirmidhi (Sunan at-Tirmidhi), compiled by Imam Abu Isa Muhammad ibn Isa at-Tirmidhi (824-892 CE), one of the six major hadith collections in Sunni Islam. Born in Termez (modern-day Uzbekistan), Imam at-Tirmidhi studied under scholars including Imam al-Bukhari. His collection contains approximately 3,956 hadiths organized into 49 books. Jami' at-Tirmidhi is unique among the six collections for its scholarly commentary, including discussion of hadith grading (sahih, hasan, da'if) and comparative opinions of various scholars on legal rulings derived from each hadith.
